page: Microsoft Azure D128ns_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine within the Dnv6 family powered by Intel x86_64 architecture processors. The virtual machine executes on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and supplies 128 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a consistent ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, suiting workloads that require a balanced distribution between memory capacity and execution parallelism. Discrete GPU acceleration is absent on this instance.

The instance is provisioned with zero bundled local temporary storage, requiring external or remote storage attachments for file systems and data persistence. It supports Azure Premium Storage to deliver predictable input/output performance for managed block devices. Furthermore, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning external ingress and egress rely on associated network interfaces, load balancers, or virtual network gateways.

Without local solid-state drives, the configuration optimizes cost efficiency for environments where persistent remote storage is standard and local scratch space is unnecessary. The D128ns_v6 is suited for large-scale enterprise web applications, high-concurrency microservice frameworks, continuous integration pipelines, batch data transformations, and relational databases backed by networked block storage.
description: The Microsoft Azure D128ns_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the network-optimized Dnv6 family. Built on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and running under Microsoft Hyper-V, the server delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration maintains a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs and provides no integrated local disk storage, depending entirely on remote solutions such as Premium Storage for persistent state. It also offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses out of the box. By omitting local storage, the instance reduces overhead for stateless architectures while delivering massive parallel compute power. The D128ns_v6 is tailored for large-scale enterprise deployments, heavily multi-threaded compute workloads, continuous integration and build nodes, relational database backends utilizing managed disks, and high-throughput application tier hosting.
